title: Agent asset playbook — audit · improve · use with agentic services

oneTruth.playerState: Railway Postgres — never D1/R2 for bag/characters

localDiskRoots.note: Local is author source; production agents must only spawn CDN/builtin URLs

knownGaps.detail: GET api.grudge-studio.com/assets ignores q/category/prefix — always returns first page (codex cold-biome accessories). free-ai loadFleetIndex pages+filters; use forge catalog/search not raw D1 API for agents.
Many D1 rows tagged accessories; path heuristics in free-ai matchFleetQuery compensate for characters/weapons/maps/nature.
First catalog/search can timeout while loading ~9k index pages. Prefer Fast assets + prefix=models/grudge6 for agent turns.

layer.name: CDN binary
layer.how: HEAD https://assets.grudge-studio.com/<r2Key> → 200, non-HTML Content-Type, size>1KB; GLB magic glTF
layer.fix: re-upload via wrangler r2 object put or GrudgeBuilder upload scripts

layer.name: D1 index row
layer.how: Row exists with r2Key matching CDN; category + name searchable via free-ai filter
layer.fix: seed-d1 / re-upsert after manifest; fix category tags

layer.name: ObjectStore def
layer.how: weapons/equipment/materials JSON ids link to iconUrl + optional mesh path

layer.name: Local author
layer.how: D:\Games\Models + _anim_packs; bake with grudge-asset-convert before R2
layer.fix: convert → R2 put → D1 seed → HEAD verify

layer.name: Texture quality
layer.how: sRGB color maps; no 1x1 placeholder; flipY false for FBX atlases; race atlas rebind

agentRules: Never invent r2Key — only Fast catalog, catalog/search, or verified HEAD
Play heroes: Toon RTS grudge6 GLB / race kits — not Meshy/capsule
Anim packs: Bip001 under _anim_packs (sword_shield, longbow, magic, rifle, pistol) + baked CDN when available
After multi-step spawn: Forge verify_mesh_scale + verify_textures
improveLoop: 1. Run scripts/audit-agent-assets.mjs (HEAD priority keys + D1 total + Fast count)
2. Fix red HEAD keys: convert if needed → wrangler r2 put → HEAD
3. Re-seed D1 categories for grudge6/weapons/nature (fix filter drift)
4. Expand Fast catalog for agent-hot paths only (not all 6k)
5. Publish agent sidecars: this playbook + roster/ai-context JSON on ObjectStore/R2
6. Legion/Forge agents load /v1/context + this playbook before inventing paths

cli: npx wrangler r2 object put grudge-assets/<key> --file=... --remote

sceneReadyCatalog.rule: Only assets.grudge-studio.com HEAD-green entries; not github.io models3d-game
